Interested in joining the ASEAN Artists Residency Programme (AARP)? 🎨 Here’s what you need to know to successfully submit your application: 📌 Visit the ASEAN website for the AARP Call for Application at: bit.ly/AARP-2026 📌 Check if you meet the eligibility criteria and requirements, including: ✔ Artist must be based in and hold Myanmar nationality. ✔ Artist must be at least 18 years old. ✔ Artist who is recognised to have sufficient experience in presenting their artwork in this context. ✔ Artist must have sufficient proficiency in English to communicate and to carry out the proposed project. ✔ Artist must be in good health and not require any special medical attention. 📌 Prepare the required application documents, including your current artist CV, your artwork proposal in 200 to 300 words, and a digital file of your artwork portfolio (less than 10 MB). 📌 Submit your application and the required documents to the AARP official email: aarp@asean.org before 31 July 2026 6:00 PM (GMT+7). Don't miss the opportunity to represent Myanmar on a regional platform and contribute with fellow ASEAN artists and contribute to ASEAN's vibrant cultural landscape through art! #ASEANArtistsResidencyProgramme

America, from space. 🛰️ To celebrate America's 250th anniversary, the USGS has created a new portrait of the nation using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9. For more than 50 years, the @USGS and @NASA Landsat program has provided a continuous record of Earth's changing land surface. This new mosaic showcases the incredible diversity of the United States, from the rainforests of the Pacific Northwest to the Everglades of Florida, from the Rocky Mountains to the agricultural heartland of the Great Plains. It also continues a tradition that began in 1976, when Landsat imagery was used to create "Portrait U.S.A." for the nation's bicentennial. Learn more about this image (also available as a poster) and download a free high-resolution copy 👉ow.ly/hLPn50ZjKhS 📷: Landsat Portrait of America, created using imagery from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 and elevation data from the USGS National Elevation Dataset.

IFAD has launched a new project to raise incomes, strengthen resilience to climate shocks and improve access to nutritious food for rural families in Afghanistan. Implemented by the Dutch Committee for Afghanistan (DCA), the Crisis Response Initiative Supplementary Financing (CRISF) will reach about 425,000 people across 13 provinces. The project builds on IFAD’s earlier Crisis Response Initiative and the Rural Poor Stimulus Facility (2021–2024), which reached more than 175,000 households. A 2024 assessment found that among participating households: 🔹 96% reported higher incomes 🔹 64% reported improved market sales 🔹 90% said the project helped them cope with climate and economic shocks CRISF will build on these gains while addressing the challenges that threaten them. With three-quarters of Afghanistan’s population dependent on livestock and subsistence farming, the project will invest in pasture and watershed management, livestock water points, and small-scale irrigation to help protect communities from drought and flooding. It will also expand access to finance through microfinance institutions, helping farmers and small enterprises grow. Read more at bit.ly/4vEzkXo #IFADImpact #FinancingTheFirstMile

PAKISTAN: Sanitation workers keep our cities running, yet many continue to work in conditions that put their lives at risk. On 4 July, two sanitation workers died and another was critically injured after inhaling toxic gases while cleaning a manhole in Chishtian, Punjab. Their deaths are the latest in a series of preventable tragedies involving sanitation workers carrying out dangerous sewer-cleaning work without adequate protection. Based on media reports, at least 16 sanitation workers have died since April 2026. Their deaths were linked to suffocation and exposure to toxic fumes while manually cleaning sewers. The dangers sanitation workers face extend beyond sewer cleaning. On 1 June, a sanitation worker was crushed to death while sweeping a road. Days later, another sanitation worker set himself on fire in Gujranwala after allegedly facing unpaid wages and unlawful salary deductions. He died from his injuries on 28 June. Reports indicate that he had repeatedly raised concerns about insufficient wages before his death.

Tariffs are back, industrial policy is fashionable again, and over the past year the United States, the country that helped build and maintain the open trading system, has spent its energy tearing holes in it, taxing allies and rivals alike. The popular verdict in India is grim: a global trade war is on, the rules-based order is finished, and we are caught in the crossfire. But is that really what's happening? In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by Devashish Mitra (@DevashishMitra_), Professor of Economics at Syracuse University's Maxwell School, and the economist who has written extensively on the political economy of trade policy. His answer is bracing on two counts. Tariffs, he argues, can't do what they promise: trade balances are governed by macroeconomics, not trade policy, and the cost of a tariff falls largely on the country that imposes it. And for India, the more uncomfortable truth is that the binding constraint was never Washington, but it's India's own protectionism. The conversation runs from Trump's tariffs to the wider drift toward industrial policy and "friend-shoring," to what the future of trade might look like and what India should actually do about it. India's female workforce participation rate among women (15+) has climbed markedly, from 19.2% in 2017–18 to 32.5% in 2025. While this expansion represents a genuine advance on the extensive margin, the terms on which women are engaged raise persistent concerns about the depth and quality of their labour market engagement. PLFS data shows that irrespective of broad sectors like agriculture, industry, or services, female employment remains located in low-productivity activities, within very small or informal enterprises, frequently in unpaid capacities in crop production and livestock; wearing apparel, textiles, tobacco manufacturing, and domestic services. Work in these segments is often part-time, supplementary, or organised on a piece-rate basis, captured through lower working hours, arrangements that constrain earnings, foreclose career progression, and no social security protection. In contrast, women remain underrepresented in high-value, knowledge-intensive industries such as scientific R&D, computer programming and consultancy, management consultancy, and legal and accounting services, those sectors that pair higher hourly wages with stable, full-time employment. Education and human health services stand out as partial exceptions, absorbing comparatively large numbers of women at earnings and hours close to the economy-wide average; yet even these sectors occupy the middle rather than the upper reaches of the distribution. The overall picture, therefore, is one of broad but shallow inclusion. While the rising share of women in the workforce is a positive development, much of this increase has been concentrated at the lower end of the labour market rather than in its most productive and remunerative segments. Expanding women's participation is therefore only the first step; equal attention must be paid to improving the quality of employment. This requires proactive measures to facilitate women's entry into higher-productivity, better-paying, and formal jobs through enterprise formalisation, expanded social protection, and improved access to finance, enabling their transition from unpaid and informal work into stable wage employment. At the same time, policy efforts should focus on increasing women's representation in emerging "future of work" sectors through targeted skilling initiatives, apprenticeships, and stronger industry partnerships. Finally, enabling women to participate fully in the labour market will require addressing persistent structural barriers by expanding affordable childcare, ensuring safe and reliable transport, and promoting flexible work arrangements. At the invitation of H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro, Chair of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM) 2026 and Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of the Philippines, Secretary-General of ASEAN Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will lead the ASEAN Secretariat’s delegation to participate in the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conferences, the 27th ASEAN Plus Three Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 16th East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, the 33rd ASEAN Regional Forum, and the meeting of the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone (SEANWFZ) Commission. The series of meetings hosted by the Philippines, as ASEAN Chair for 2026, will take place in Manila, the Philippines, on 18-24 July 2026, under the theme “Navigating Our Future, Together.” While in Manila, Dr. Kao will hold bilateral meetings with Foreign Ministers from ASEAN Member States and ASEAN’s external partners to explore ways to further strengthen ASEAN’s cooperation and partnership in support of the implementation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. Dr. Kao is also scheduled to hold an interface with the ASEAN Intergovernmental Commission on Human Rights (AICHR) Representatives on the margins of the 59th AMM and Related Meetings. Concluding the series of meetings, Dr. Kao will participate in the commemorative activities marking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on 24 July 2026, including the high-level Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the TAC, the signing ceremony for new High Contracting Parties to the TAC, and the Gala Dinner to be hosted by H.E. Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., President of the Republic of the Philippines and ASEAN Chair for 2026.

The municipal government of Talacogon, Agusan del Sur, is preparing for the 40th-day remembrance of Ateneo basketball player Rene Clert Baterbonia, who died during a team-building activity in Aurora on June 8. Days before the commemoration on Saturday, July 18, people continue to visit Baterbonia’s tomb at the Talacogon Cemetery in Barangay Labnig, inspired by the story of the young and promising athlete who pursued his dream in Manila but tragically died just four days later. A memorial Mass will be held at 8 a.m., followed by a simple remembrance program, according to Rene’s mother, Rovelyn Baterbonia, who also invited supporters to join the event. The municipal government said preparations for Saturday’s commemoration are already in place and urged visitors to follow the designated site plan. POR QUÉ LA DERROTA ANTE ARGENTINA FUE “LA MÁS DOLOROSA EN 60 AÑOS DE SUFRIMIENTO”, SEGÚN UN PRESTIGIOSO MEDIO INGLÉS La eliminación de Inglaterra a manos de Argentina en la semifinal del Mundial dejó una huella difícil de borrar en la memoria colectiva del fútbol británico. El equipo europeo, que soñaba con romper una sequía de seis décadas sin alcanzar la gloria máxima, vio cómo esa oportunidad se desvanecía en los últimos minutos de un partido cargado de emociones y decisiones polémicas. La pregunta que se debatió el medio BBC Sport tras el pitido final fue sencilla pero profunda: “¿Por qué la derrota de Inglaterra ante Argentina se sintió como la más dolorosa en 60 años de sufrimiento?”. En el análisis publicado por Phil McNulty, redactor jefe de fútbol americano en Atlanta, se abordó de frente esta cuestión. Según su perspectiva, “Inglaterra ha sufrido mucho a lo largo de los años, pero como observador que cubrió su séptimo Mundial, así como aquellas derrotas en las finales de la Eurocopa, esta se sintió como la peor”. La afirmación no es menor: la sensación de haber estado tan cerca y, aun así, volver a tropezar, caló hondo en el ánimo de jugadores y simpatizantes. El contexto de la derrota se agrava porque, más allá de la caída frente a un rival histórico, lo que más pesó fue la certeza de que la semifinal representaba una oportunidad inmejorable. “Dadas las circunstancias, esta es una derrota que se analizará con más detenimiento, que generará más pesar, que cualquier otra”, concluyó McNulty. 📲 Leé la nota completa 🔗 infob.ae/4bMw4lw

Under the leadership of Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta, Delhi has taken a historic step towards citizen-first governance with the approval of the Delhi (Right of Citizen to Time Bound and Ease of Delivery of Services) Bill, 2026. The new law gives every citizen a legal right to receive notified government services within a fixed timeline, making governance faster, simpler, more transparent and accountable. Time-bound service delivery, automatic escalation of delayed cases, an independent grievance redressal mechanism, a Right to Service Commission and penalties for negligence will ensure that citizens receive the services they are entitled to without unnecessary delays. #ViksitDelhi Video

As warfare evolves with new technologies, the course brings together military leaders, strategic thinkers, and defence practitioners to deliberate on the future of warfare and national security. We are honoured to welcome Mr Tejas Bharadwaj as a speaker at FWC-4. A Senior Research Analyst with the Technology and Society Program at Carnegie India, he specialises in space law, space security, and the governance of emerging technologies. His work focuses on India’s evolving space sector, space sustainability, AI in the military domain, autonomous weapons systems, defence technology partnerships, and cybersecurity policy. STORY | US introduces fixed-term for student, exchange visas The US on Thursday tightened the rules governing visas for foreign students, exchange visitors and journalists, ending the old regime that allowed them to stay in the country indefinitely without government oversight. The new regulation establishes a fixed period of admission for non-immigrant visa holders in F, J, and I classifications, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) said in a statement here. The F category visas are for students, the J category for exchange visitors, and the I category is for journalists. Non-immigrant students (F visas) and exchange visitors (J visas) will be admitted for the length of their specific programme, not to exceed a maximum period of four years, the DHS said in a statement. “For decades, foreign students have been admitted into the US indefinitely, allowing thousands to abuse our immigration system by perpetually enrolling in courses to avoid having to leave the US,” DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said in a statement here. Хтось боїться за свій підрозділ, розуміючи, що після відвертої оцінки дій Головнокомандувача його людей можуть спрямувати на провальний напрямок або залишити без належного забезпечення. Ваші командири несуть відповідальність за вас, за ваші життя і за боєздатність своїх підрозділів. Саме тому їхня чесність перед Верховним Головнокомандувачем є частиною цієї відповідальності. With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. ⚡️The three circles belong to one war system. Hormuz, Bab el-Mandeb, and the eastern Mediterranean are the valves controlling the region’s movement of oil, gas, weapons, capital, shipping, data, and political influence. Whoever controls the valves controls the price of access. Whoever can threaten them cheaply can extract concessions far beyond their conventional military strength. The future fight is over route sovereignty. The United States and Gulf states are building redundancy through pipelines, ports, protected sea lanes, new insurance structures, Mediterranean outlets, military escorts, and governments tied into the same commercial architecture. Israel attacks the Iranian networks capable of sabotaging that system. Turkey competes to route the northern branch through territory it can influence. Oman gains power by administering the passage rules. Iraq and Syria become the land bridge whose alignment determines whether Gulf energy can reach the Mediterranean without Iranian permission. Iran’s answer is distributed veto power. Mines at Hormuz. Houthis near Bab el-Mandeb. Militias across Iraq. Hezbollah and remnants across the Levant. Drones against pumping stations. Missiles against ports. Cyberattacks against logistics. One cheap weapon can raise the cost of an entire corridor because insurers and shipowners react before governments establish attribution. That is the decisive asymmetry. A state must defend thousands of miles of infrastructure continuously. A proxy needs one successful strike. The next regional order will therefore be armed infrastructure. Pipelines guarded like borders. Ports treated like military bases. Shipping lanes administered through permits and surveillance. Insurance backed by governments. Air defenses protecting commercial corridors. Proxy attacks used as price signals during negotiations. Peace will exist as managed throughput. Ships will move. Oil will flow. Governments will announce stability. Underneath, every route will remain protected, contested, and priced for attack. The image gets one thing wrong. Food crises do not begin or end at national borders. COVID-19, conflict, climate and economic shocks and disruptions to energy, fertiliser and trade have shown how quickly pressure in one part of the world can spread through food systems and reach communities thousands of miles away. At the #HLPF in New York, @IFAD hosted a High-Level Roundtable on a difficult but necessary question: How do we finance agrifood systems that can better withstand the next shock? The discussion confirmed that this is no longer only an agricultural issue. Food-system resilience is inseparable from economic security, geopolitical stability and international cooperation. Shocks are transmitted through energy, fertiliser, trade and food markets. In many African countries, for example, more than 80% of fertiliser is imported. Disruption or price volatility in global markets can therefore quickly affect planting decisions, harvests and rural incomes. Small-scale producers and rural entrepreneurs feel these pressures first. Rising input costs and reduced access to finance determine whether they can plant, invest, hire workers or take produce to market. But vulnerability can be reduced. Better fertiliser application and combining organic and inorganic inputs can cut fertiliser use by 25–30% while sustaining or increasing yields. What happens at the #FirstMile shapes food availability, prices, and rural incomes. If disruptions persist, as many as 45 million additional people could face acute food insecurity. Resilience must be financed before the next crisis arrives. That investment must begin at the first mile. Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua, Prime Minister of Tonga, underlined this and brought in the perspective of countries already facing climate and economic vulnerability. Through #IFAD14, we can bring governments, development finance institutions, the private sector and other partners around a shared agenda: addressing immediate food-security pressures while building stronger rural economies and more resilient agrifood systems. @GovIE | @ItalyMFA_int | @ItalyMFA | @MFAEthiopia | @PolandMFA | @PremierRP | @RockefellerFdn #FinancingTheFirstMile

al-Hidayah Australia 2026 📷 | Day 2: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Delivers Landmark Keynote Address on Language, Identity and the Future of Faith Australia: On the second day of Al-Hidayah Australia 2026, His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri delivered a landmark keynote address exploring the profound relationship between language, faith, identity, and the preservation of Islam among future generations living in the English-speaking world. The lecture formed the third and concluding instalment of his international series addressing the challenges confronting Muslim families raising children in Western societies. Drawing upon theology, sociology, history, linguistics, and contemporary academic research, Shaykh-ul-Islam examined what he described as one of the most pressing issues facing the Ummah today: the growing phenomenon of "English-only dependence" and its implications for the transmission of faith. At the outset of his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam congratulated the organisers, volunteers, speakers, and participants of Al-Hidayah Australia 2026, appreciating the collective efforts of Minhaj-ul-Quran Australia, Minhaj Welfare Foundation Australia, Minhaj Women League Australia, Eagles Australia, Minhaj Youth League, and all those who contributed to making the educational retreat a success. He also announced that the next phase of this important series would continue at Al-Hidayah Canada 2026 at McMaster University later this year. English is Not the Problem A central theme of the keynote address was Shaykh-ul-Islam's clarification that the English language itself is not a threat to Islam or Muslim identity. He explained that English has become indispensable in today's world, serving as the language of education, professional advancement, public engagement, communication, and intellectual discourse. Muslim youth, he stressed, must master English in order to excel academically, contribute positively to society, and confidently articulate Islamic perspectives in response to modern ideological challenges such as atheism, secularism, and liberalism. However, he warned that the real challenge arises when English becomes the only language through which Muslim children understand religion, identity, and meaning. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, when religious understanding becomes confined solely to English, future generations gradually lose access to the vast inherited reservoirs of Islamic scholarship, spirituality, and civilisation that have sustained Muslim communities for centuries. The Three-Language Model Presenting what he described as the "Three-Language Ideal Model" for Muslim families living in the West, Shaykh-ul-Islam proposed a balanced framework for preserving both faith and identity. He explained that English should remain the language of education, communication, and engagement with the modern world; the heritage language—whether Urdu, Turkish, Persian, or another inherited Muslim language—should serve as the bridge to religious, spiritual, and cultural inheritance; while Arabic remains the gateway to the original sources of Islam, including the Holy Qur'an, Hadith, Sunnah, and classical Islamic scholarship. He emphasised that the solution is not to replace one language with another, but to ensure that each language fulfils its unique role. Summarising this model, Shaykh-ul-Islam stated: "Keep English strong, keep the heritage language alive, and connect with Arabic." Language Shapes Thought and Identity Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that language is far more than a means of communication—it shapes thought, perception, worldview, and moral understanding. Children, he said, do not merely speak through language; they think through it, interpret reality through it, and develop their intellectual and ethical frameworks through it. He warned that when Muslim children become exclusively dependent upon English, they often begin to understand religion through the assumptions and categories of the secular environment in which English predominantly functions. As a result, their understanding of Islam can gradually become detached from the civilisational, spiritual, and intellectual traditions that originally nurtured the faith, contributing to the growing identity crisis experienced by many Muslim youth in Western societies. Heritage Languages Preserve Islamic Civilisation Highlighting the importance of heritage languages, Shaykh-ul-Islam described them as vital carriers of Islamic civilisation and religious knowledge. Using Urdu as an example, he explained how it developed through centuries of interaction between Arabic, Persian, and Turkish traditions, becoming a powerful vehicle for Islamic scholarship, spirituality, and culture. He noted that heritage languages preserve not only knowledge but also emotional memory, inherited values, manners, etiquette, and essential religious vocabulary. Expressions such as Insha'Allah, Masha'Allah, SubhanAllah, Tawakkul, Sabr, and Shukr carry profound spiritual meanings that become deeply rooted within a child's subconscious understanding of faith. When such expressions disappear from daily life, he observed, the concepts they represent gradually disappear as well. Access to Authentic Islamic Scholarship A significant portion of the keynote focused on the relationship between language and access to authentic Islamic knowledge. Shaykh-ul-Islam explained that the original sources of Islam—including the Holy Qur'an, Hadith, Islamic jurisprudence, theology, spirituality, and classical scholarship—are preserved in the Arabic language. He further noted that vast portions of Islamic intellectual heritage have also been transmitted through Turkish and Persian scholarly traditions, with Urdu serving as an important bridge connecting later generations to this rich legacy. Without access to these linguistic traditions, he cautioned, Muslim youth become increasingly dependent upon translations and secondary interpretations, limiting their ability to engage deeply with the richness and depth of Islamic scholarship. The Rise of "Algorithmic Religion" One of the most significant themes of the address was Shaykh-ul-Islam's warning against what he termed "algorithmic religion." He observed that many young Muslims today no longer acquire religious understanding primarily through scholars, books, families, or established institutions. Instead, they increasingly receive religious information through platforms such as TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, podcasts, social media influencers, AI-generated responses, and algorithm-driven digital feeds. In such an environment, young people encounter atheist critiques, secular liberal perspectives, hyper-literalist interpretations, ultra-modern ideologies, influencer-based religion, and countless conflicting viewpoints simultaneously. Without grounding in authentic scholarship and inherited religious traditions, Shaykh-ul-Islam warned, many lack the ability to distinguish between sound Islamic knowledge and misinformation. He described this phenomenon as "algorithmic religion"—a personalised version of faith assembled from random digital fragments selected by algorithms rather than guided by authentic scholarship, tradition, or religious authority. According to Shaykh-ul-Islam, this trend contributes to religious confusion, weakening family transmission of faith, inconsistent religious practice, identity instability, and spiritual uncertainty. Faith is Transmitted Through the Heart Throughout the lecture, Shaykh-ul-Islam repeatedly emphasised that faith is not transmitted through intellectual reasoning alone. While rational understanding remains essential, religion is also conveyed through love, belonging, emotional attachment, memory, spiritual experience, family traditions, and inherited religious culture. He explained that many dimensions of Islamic life continue through sentimental and spiritual connections that exist beyond intellectual explanations. These connections are preserved through language, family practices, and cultural expressions that ultimately connect believers to the Prophetic tradition itself. Without these channels of transmission, future generations may retain information about Islam while gradually losing their emotional and spiritual attachment to it. Culture as a System of Meaning Shaykh-ul-Islam challenged the common misconception that culture is merely a collection of local customs or ethnic traditions. Instead, he defined culture as a comprehensive system of meaning, consisting of values, beliefs, concepts, norms, manners, habits, and traditions rooted in faith. Islamic culture, he explained, transcends geography and ethnicity. It is formed through the shared meanings transmitted by the Holy Qur'an, the Sunnah, Islamic scholarship, and the rich spiritual heritage of Islam. Language, he stressed, plays a central role in preserving and transmitting this system of meaning across generations. Research Supporting Faith Transmission Supporting his arguments with contemporary academic research, Shaykh-ul-Islam referred to studies demonstrating that retention of heritage languages strengthens religious continuity, reinforces family bonds, and contributes significantly to preserving faith among immigrant Muslim communities living in Western societies. These findings, he observed, confirm what religious communities have understood for generations—that faith is sustained not only through doctrine but also through family, language, culture, and emotional belonging. A Powerful Call to Muslim Families Concluding his keynote address, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a heartfelt appeal to Muslim parents, educators, and community leaders. He urged families not to see language as a choice between modern success and religious commitment. Instead, they should equip future generations with all three essential dimensions: Strong English for success in the contemporary world. Strong heritage language for preserving identity and religious continuity. Strong Arabic connection for direct access to the original sources of Islam. Shaykh-ul-Islam warned that neglecting heritage transmission risks disconnecting future generations from the religious, moral, and spiritual foundations that sustain faith. Bringing his address to a close, he reminded participants that preserving Islam is not merely an intellectual exercise but a holistic process encompassing knowledge, identity, family, language, culture, spirituality, and the heart. For Muslim communities living in the English-speaking world, he concluded, the challenge is not English itself—but ensuring that English does not become the only lens through which future generations encounter their faith. #AlHidayah2026 #ShaykhulIslam #TahirulQadri #Australia #MinhajulQuran

PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

An outreach programme on the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues was organised today at DRDO Bhawan by the Directorate of Management & Security (DMS), DRDO. The programme commenced with an address by Dr. Ravindra Singh, DG (R&M), who highlighted the importance of awareness and compliance with the latest income tax provisions. The technical sessions were delivered by Ms. Beenu, Additional Commissioner of Income Tax; Shri Y. N. Saxena, Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax; and the team from Aaykar Bhawan, New Delhi who provided detailed insights into the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues while addressing participants' queries. The interactive sessions enhanced participants understanding of the new tax framework and strengthened statutory compliance among DDOs and PAOs across DRDO. The programme concluded with a Vote of Thanks by the Director DMS.

#WATCH | Bradford, UK | Members of the Kashmiri diaspora staged an anti-Pakistan protest outside the Pakistani Consulate in Bradford, United Kingdom, on July 15, alleging human rights violations in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK). The protest was organised on the call of the Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC), with participants urging the international community to take note of what they described as state repression in PoJK. Protesters carried placards and raised slogans against Pakistan, accusing its security forces of human rights abuses in the region. The demonstrators alleged that Pakistani security forces had carried out killings, enforced abductions, raids on homes, and violence against civilians, including women and children. They also demanded that the rights and demands of the people of Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir be respected and addressed. During the protest, participants also called for a boycott of travel and tourism to Pakistan, urged people to avoid flying with Pakistan International Airlines (PIA), and appealed to the Kashmiri diaspora to stop remittances to Pakistan until their demands were met. नागरिकांच्या सोयीला प्राधान्य, शासकीय सेवांमध्ये सुलभीकरणाला वेग मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे 'गव्हर्नन्स प्रोसेस री-इंजिनिअरिंग - टप्पा 3' संदर्भात आढावा बैठक पार पडली. शासकीय सुधारणांचा जास्तीत जास्त नागरिकांना लाभ व्हावा यासाठी 15 ऑगस्टपर्यंत सर्व विभागांनी गतीने काम करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्य शासनाच्या गव्हर्नन्स प्रोसेस री-इंजिनियरिंग (जीपीआर) उपक्रमांतर्गत शासकीय सेवा अधिक सुलभ, पारदर्शक व तंत्रज्ञानाधारित करण्याच्या प्रक्रियेला गती देण्यात येत असून, सर्व विभागांनी 15 ऑगस्टपर्यंत भरीव प्रगती करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. तसेच प्रत्येक सेवेचे नव्याने पुनरावलोकन करून कागदपत्रांची संख्या कमी करावी. 'महाराष्ट्राची सर्वाधिक सुलभ शासकीय सेवा देणारे राज्य' अशी ओळख निर्माण करण्यासाठी सर्व विभागांनी समन्वयाने काम करावे, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. ‘जीपीआर’ अंतर्गत प्रत्येक सेवेसाठी 6 टप्प्यांची प्रक्रिया निश्चित करण्यात आली असून त्यामध्ये जीपीआर अहवाल, मुख्यमंत्री कार्यालयाशी चर्चा, विभागीय मंजुरी, महाआयटीमार्फत तांत्रिक विकास, शासन निर्णय निर्गमित करणे आणि अंतिम चाचणी यांचा समावेश आहे. सर्व विभागांनी 15 ऑगस्टपर्यंत किमान पाचव्या टप्प्यापर्यंत, म्हणजे आवश्यक शासन निर्णय निर्गमित करून सेवा अंतिम चाचणीसाठी तयार ठेवाव्यात, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, राज्यातील नागरिकांना जलद, पारदर्शक आणि सुलभ सेवा उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी शासनाने शासकीय सेवांचे व्यापक पुनरावलोकन केले आहे. त्यानुसार विविध विभागांतील सेवांचे एकत्रीकरण व सुलभीकरण करून सेवांची संख्या निश्चित करण्यात आली आहे. यामध्ये दुहेरी सेवांचे एकत्रीकरण तसेच कालबाह्य व अन्य सेवांची समाप्ती करण्यात आली आहे. महाडीबीटी 2.0, मैत्री आणि आपले सरकार 2.0 या डिजिटल प्लॅटफॉर्मवर सर्व शासकीय सेवा टप्प्याटप्प्याने उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. सेवा वितरणात कोणताही तांत्रिक अडथळा येणार नाही, यासाठी माहिती तंत्रज्ञान विभागाने सक्षम तांत्रिक व्यवस्था उभारावी, तसेच सर्व कामे निश्चित कालमर्यादेत पूर्ण करावीत, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. डेटा ॲनालिटिक्स ॲज अ सर्व्हिस आणि मिनी सेतू केंद्र प्रकल्पांचे लोकार्पण मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस New Policy Brief | From Mobile-First to Mobile-Plus: Closing India's Fixed-Mobile Imbalance Of India's 1080.15 million broadband connections in May 2026, only 47.40 million, less than 5%, were wireline. This unusually high mobile-fixed imbalance sets India apart from most countries. A mobile-first approach delivered affordable access at scale and accelerated internet adoption, but the absence of a complementary fixed-line backbone compromises quality and risks undermining productive end use, innovation, and network resilience as networks mature. ICRIER's latest policy brief, authored by Aarti R., Shailly Gupta, and Payal Malik, maps fixed wireline policies across countries and translates them into targeted reforms for India: a ringfenced, legislatively mandated transfer mechanism for the Digital Bharat Nidhi; accelerated copper-to-fibre conversion at BSNL/MTNL and faster Right of Way at the municipal level; mandatory wholesale access and an AGR levy offset for rural fibre capex; and harmonised state-level planning to address acute imbalances in states like Assam, Odisha, and Rajasthan. ਭਲਕੇ ਜਲੰਧਰ ਵਿੱਚ 5400 ਕਰੋੜ ਰੁਪਏ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਦੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਉਦਘਾਟਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ ਜਾਂ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਨੀਂਹ ਪੱਥਰ ਰੱਖੇ ਜਾਣਗੇ। ਭਲਕੇ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਰੇਲਵੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਢਾਂਚੇ ਲਈ ਬਹੁਤ ਅਹਿਮ ਹੈ ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਰਤ ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨ ਸਕੀਮ ਤਹਿਤ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਰਤ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ 75 ਮੁੜ-ਵਿਕਸਿਤ ਰੇਲਵੇ ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੇਸ਼ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰਪਿਤ ਕੀਤੇ ਜਾਣਗੇ। ਇਹ ਸਟੇਸ਼ਨ ਯਾਤਰੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਸਹੂਲਤਾਂ ਯਕੀਨੀ ਬਣਾਉਣਗੇ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ, ਇਹ ‘ਵਿਕਾਸ ਭੀ, ਵਿਰਾਸਤ ਭੀ’ ਦੀ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਦਰਸਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਹੋਰ ਰੇਲਵੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਸ਼੍ਰੀ ਆਨੰਦਪੁਰ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਂ ਚਿੰਤਪੁਰਨੀ ਮੰਦਰ ਤੱਕ ਕਨੈਕਟੀਵਿਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਬਿਹਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣਗੇ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ, ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਰਾਣਸੀ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਟਰੇਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਭਾਰਤ ਦੇ ਦੋ ਅਹਿਮ ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਅਤੇ ਸੱਭਿਆਚਾਰਕ ਕੇਂਦਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜੋੜੇਗੀ।

The smoke turned the skies gray in affected areas on Wednesday, compounding a heat wave. Tonga’s leadership matters far beyond its shores. For Small Island Developing States, resilient food systems are central to climate adaptation, food security and economic stability. On the margins of #HLPF in New York, I held bilateral discussions with the Prime Minister of #Tonga, Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua highlighting the long standing partnership between @IFAD and Tonga. IFAD and Tonga have worked together since 1983. Our total investment has reached more than US$53 million, including US$22 million in IFAD financing, supporting rural communities and expanding opportunities, particularly in the outer islands. Our shared priority is the development of value chains and opening markets for small holder producers from outer islands to main islands and regional markets. The Tonga Rural Innovation Project Phase III marks the next stage of this partnership. Financed by a US$5.3 million IFAD grant and US$4.7 million in climate co-financing, it will strengthen climate-resilient agriculture, improve food and nutrition security, and create new economic opportunities for approximately 35,000 people. Across the Pacific, IFAD has mobilized more than US$400 million in investments over four decades, helping countries strengthen resilience, food security and sustainable rural livelihoods. As we look towards #IFAD14, our focus is on mobilizing greater investment in rural people, climate adaptation, nutrition and sustainable food systems across Tonga and the wider Pacific. #FinancingTheFirstMile

An outreach programme on the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues was organised today at DRDO Bhawan by the Directorate of Management & Security (DMS), DRDO. The programme commenced with an address by Dr. Ravindra Singh, DG (R&M), who highlighted the importance of awareness and compliance with the latest income tax provisions. The technical sessions were delivered by Ms. Beenu, Additional Commissioner of Income Tax; Shri Y. N. Saxena, Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax; and the team from Aaykar Bhawan, New Delhi who provided detailed insights into the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 2025, Income Tax Rules, 2026, and TDS-related issues while addressing participants' queries. The interactive sessions enhanced participants understanding of the new tax framework and strengthened statutory compliance among DDOs and PAOs across DRDO. The programme concluded with a Vote of Thanks by the Director DMS.

संसद का मॉनसून सत्र शुरू होने जा रहा है। इस अवसर पर कांग्रेस पार्टी के वरिष्ठ नेता जयराम रमेश जी ने सत्र के संदर्भ में अपने विचार व्यक्त किए हैं। लेकिन मैं विनम्रता और दृढ़ता से कांग्रेस पार्टी से एक प्रश्न पूछना चाहता हूं कि आप ‘फ्लोर ऑफ द हाउस’ पर यह आरोप लगा रहे हैं कि इंडी गठबंधन के दलों में तोड़फोड़ हो रही है। मेरा सीधा सवाल है कि क्या इंडी गठबंधन का औपचारिक अस्तित्व है? क्या लोकसभा और राज्यसभा में आपने लोकसभा अध्यक्ष तथा राज्यसभा के सभापति को लिखित रूप में यह सूचित किया है कि कौन-कौन से दल इंडी गठबंधन के सदस्य हैं और उन सभी दलों ने मिलकर किस नेता को गठबंधन का नेता चुना है? यदि ऐसा नहीं है, तो जिस गठबंधन का औपचारिक अस्तित्व ही स्पष्ट नहीं है, उसके विखंडन का आरोप दूसरों पर लगाकर अपनी नाकामियों को छिपाने का असफल प्रयास मत कीजिए। आज इंडी गठबंधन की स्थिति यह है कि एक दल को दूसरे दल पर भरोसा नहीं है, यहां तक कि उनके सांसदों को भी एक-दूसरे पर विश्वास नहीं रह गया है। मुझे लगता है कि कांग्रेस पार्टी को आत्मावलोकन करना चाहिए। आज जयराम रमेश जी अपनी बौद्धिकता का आवरण जितना भी फैला लें, वह राहुल गांधी जी की अक्षमता और अकुशलता को नहीं ढक सकते। प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र जी के नेतृत्व में देश जिस कुशलता और गति से आगे बढ़ रहा है, उसका स्वागत कीजिए। संसद में जिन मुद्दों पर सकारात्मक और सार्थक चर्चा करनी है, उन पर चर्चा कीजिए। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

ड्रग्सविरोधी लढा अधिक तीव्र मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे 'अमली पदार्थमुक्त महाराष्ट्र : व्यूहरचना आणि कृती आराखड्या'संदर्भात बैठक पार पडली. नैसर्गिकरित्या उपलब्ध होणाऱ्या अमली पदार्थांचे उत्पादन, पुरवठा, खरेदी-विक्री व्यवहार आणि कृत्रिमरित्या तयार करण्यात येणाऱ्या अमली पदार्थांची निर्मिती व पुरवठा व्यवसायाच्या अर्थव्यवस्थेला मुळापासून उखडून टाकण्याचे निर्देश देत, सशक्त महाराष्ट्रासाठी व्यसनमुक्तीच्या चळवळीत सर्वांचे योगदान आवश्यक असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. शालेय जीवनापासूनच अमली पदार्थांच्या दुष्परिणामांविषयी विद्यार्थ्यांमध्ये जागृती निर्माण करण्यासाठी इयत्ता सातवी ते दहावीच्या अभ्यासक्रमामध्ये अमली पदार्थांच्या दुष्परिणामांविषयी घटकांचा समावेश करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले की, नशेच्या दुर्दैवी चक्रव्यूहातून बाहेर पडण्याची इच्छा असलेल्यांसाठी नशामुक्ती केंद्रांची साखळी उभारावी. स्वयंसेवी संस्थांच्या सहकार्याने राज्यामध्ये वैद्यकीय शिक्षण, सार्वजनिक आरोग्य आणि अमली पदार्थविरोधी कक्ष यांच्या समन्वयातून नशामुक्ती केंद्रे उभारण्यात यावीत. मुंबई शहरामध्ये मुंबई महापालिकेने अमली पदार्थविरोधी कक्षाच्या सहकार्याने स्वतंत्र बहुशाखीय नशामुक्ती केंद्रांची सुविधा सुरू करावी. त्यासोबतच राज्यातील मोठी रुग्णालये व सर्व शासकीय रुग्णालयांमध्ये काही मर्यादित खाटांची नशामुक्ती केंद्रे सुरू करावीत. नशामुक्त झालेला व्यक्ती पुन्हा नशेच्या गर्तेत जाऊ नये, यासाठी राज्यामध्ये मुक्ती केंद्रांची साखळीच तयार करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले की, मुख्याध्यापक व प्राचार्य यांच्या माध्यमातून संबंधित शाळा व महाविद्यालयांतील विद्यार्थ्यांमध्ये अमली पदार्थांच्या दुष्परिणामांविषयी जागृती करावी. संबंधित प्राचार्य आणि मुख्याध्यापकांनी आपल्या शैक्षणिक संस्थेचा परिसर अमली पदार्थमुक्त घोषित करण्यासाठी नियमावली तयार करावी. अमली पदार्थ विषयक गुन्ह्यांमध्ये एनडीपीएस (नार्कोटिक ड्रग्ज अँड सायकोट्रॉपिक सबस्टन्सेस ॲक्ट) सारख्या कायद्यांचा प्रभावी उपयोग करून प्रकरणांचा जलद निकाल लागण्यासाठी जलदगती न्यायालये स्थापन करावीत. शासनातर्फे अशा प्रकरणांमध्ये आरोपींना शिक्षा होण्यासाठी न्यायालयात बाजू मांडणाऱ्या सरकारी वकिलांचे प्रशिक्षण घेण्यात यावे. शासनाच्या सर्व विभागांच्या समन्वयातून अमली पदार्थांशी निगडित संपूर्ण अर्थव्यवस्थेवर कारवाई करण्यात येईल. अमली पदार्थांचा पुरवठा करणाऱ्या पेडलर्सना शोधून त्यांच्याकडून पुरवठा साखळीतील मागील आणि पुढील दुवे शोधून त्यांच्यावर कडक कारवाई करण्यात यावी. पोलिसांनी आपल्या कार्यक्षेत्रातील अमली पदार्थांची विक्री होत असलेली ठिकाणे शोधून त्या ठिकाणी गस्त वाढवावी. कुणीही या व्यवसायाशी निगडित असल्यास त्याची गय केली जाणार नाही, असेही स्पष्ट निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. अमली पदार्थविरोधी तसेच नशामुक्त महाराष्ट्राच्या निर्मितीसाठी उल्लेखनीय काम केलेल्या आणि गोपनीय माहितीच्या आधारे मोठ्या कारवाया घडवून आणण्यास मदत केलेल्या सामान्य नागरिकांसाठी बक्षीस योजना लागू करावी. अमली पदार्थ विषयक गुन्ह्यांमध्ये चांगली कामगिरी करणाऱ्या अधिकारी व कर्मचाऱ्यांना मूळ वेतनाच्या 3% आगाऊ वेतन देण्याची कार्यवाही करावी. तसेच अमली पदार्थांच्या गुन्ह्यांमध्ये तपास करणाऱ्या अधिकाऱ्यांना परिस्थितीनुरूप विमानप्रवासाची सवलत देण्यात यावी. याबाबतीत उल्लेखनीय कामगिरी करणाऱ्या अधिकारी व कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी पुरस्कार योजना सुरू करावी, असेही निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. अमली पदार्थविरोधी कारवाई :- 2021 ते 2025 या दरम्यान पोलिसांनी केलेल्या विविध कारवायांमध्ये ₹6,550 कोटी किमतीचे 5.7 टन मेफेड्रोन जप्त करण्यात आले आहे. तसेच 134 किलो वजनाची ₹484.75 कोटी किमतीची हेरॉईन, 109.7 टन वजनाचा ₹186.44 कोटी किमतीचा गांजा, ₹14.67 कोटी किमतीचे 759 किलो चरस आणि ₹14.60 कोटी किमतीचे 134 किलो कोकेन जप्त करण्यात आले आहे. तसेच 2025 मध्ये 17,611 प्रकरणांमध्ये 56,206 किलो विविध अमली पदार्थ जप्त करण्यात आले असून त्यांची किंमत ₹1340 कोटी आहे. या प्रकरणांमध्ये 15,994 आरोपींना अटक करण्यात आली असून, त्यापैकी 72 विदेशी नागरिक होते. यावेळी मंत्री प्रकाश आबिटकर, राज्यमंत्री माधुरी मिसाळ, राज्यात उभारणार जागतिक दर्जाची कर्करोग उपचार व्यवस्था मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे 'महाराष्ट्र कॅन्सर केअर, रिसर्च अँड एज्युकेशन फाउंडेशन'च्या संचालक मंडळाची पहिली बैठक पार पडली. राज्यातील कर्करोग रुग्णांवर उपचारासाठी महाराष्ट्र कॅन्सर केअर, रिसर्च अँड एज्युकेशन फाऊंडेशन कंपनीच्या (महाकेअर) माध्यमातून आंतरराष्ट्रीय दर्जाच्या उपचार व संशोधन सुविधा निर्माण कराव्यात, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. आधुनिक तंत्रज्ञान, आर्थिकदृष्ट्या सक्षम आणि राज्य-शासित एल 2 व एल 3 कर्करोग रुग्णालयांच्या माध्यमातून महाराष्ट्रातील प्रत्येक जिल्ह्यातील प्रत्येक व्यक्तीला निदानापासून उपचारापर्यंत समान व जागतिक दर्जाची कर्करोग सेवा उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी महाकेअर कंपनीची भूमिका महत्त्वाची ठरणार आहे. त्या माध्यमातून राज्यातील कर्करुग्णांची संख्या कमी होण्याची शक्यता आहे. त्यामुळे महाकेअरसाठी मनुष्यबळ उभारताना उच्च दर्जाची क्षमता असलेले मनुष्यबळ घ्यावे, अशा सूचना मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिल्या. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी महाकेअर अंतर्गत नागपूरमध्ये नागपूर हाय एनर्जी मेडिकल सायक्लोट्रॉन प्रोजेक्ट या उपकंपनीची स्थापना करण्यास मान्यता दिली. महाकेअर कंपनीच्या कॉर्पस निधीसाठी ₹100 कोटी महात्मा फुले जनआरोग्य योजनेतून देण्यास तत्वतः मान्यता देण्यात आली. तसेच सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व निधी उभारणे व स्वीकारणे, महाकेअरच्या कार्यालयासाठी जी.टी. रुग्णालय येथील इमारतीत जागा उपलब्ध करून देणे, कंपनीचे लेखापरीक्षक व कंपनी सचिवांची नियुक्ती करणे, सल्लागार नेमणे आदी विषयांनाही संचालक मंडळाच्या बैठकीत मान्यता देण्यात आली. यावेळी टाटा मेमोरियल कॅन्सर हॉस्पिटलबरोबर तांत्रिक सहकार्यासाठी सामंजस्य करार करण्यात आला. महाकेअरची व्याप्ती ✅ महाकेअर कंपनीमार्फत विकेंद्रीत सेवा प्रणालीद्वारे कर्करोर उपचार पद्धतीत परिवर्तन होणार ✅ याअंतर्गत टाटा मेमोरियल हॉस्पिटल येथे सर्वोच्च संशोधन व कर्करोग उपचार केंद्र ✅ मुंबई, पुणे, छत्रपती DG BSF conveys his heartiest congratulations and extends his best wishes for continued success in future international competitions.

"Finally, on Monday next week, @UN Member States will meet in New York for the High-Level Meeting on #RoadSafety. We expect Member States to adopt a strong political declaration, which they have been negotiating over the past few months. It commits them to implementing national road safety strategies with clear targets, timelines and budgets. The draft declaration also includes commitments to establish road safety agencies, improve data collection, develop and enforce strong laws, and ensure infrastructure and vehicles meet key safety standards. It also commits countries to adopt the proven “safe systems” approach, which accepts that people will always make mistakes on the roads, and so designs roads, speed limits and rules around levels the human body can survive when a crash occurs. To coincide with the meeting, WHO will also publish a new report next week showing encouraging progress in road safety, although insufficient to meet the global target of a 50% reduction in deaths and serious injuries by 2030"-@DrTedros

"#Dementia is among the greatest health and social challenges of our time, touching people, families, and communities everywhere. More than 57 million people live with dementia worldwide and almost 10 million people are newly diagnosed every year. Alzheimer’s disease is the most common form of dementia, accounting for 60 to 70% of cases. While there is no cure for dementia, it can be prevented or delayed by avoiding risk factors including tobacco, alcohol use, social isolation, physical inactivity, air pollution, and by treating high blood pressure, diabetes and hearing loss. Yesterday, WHO published updated guidelines on reducing the risk of dementia and cognitive decline, providing practical, evidence-based recommendations. Protecting brain health is not the responsibility of the health sector alone. It requires coordinated action across governments, communities, and systems. WHO calls on all countries and partners to integrate dementia risk reduction into primary health care and programmes for noncommunicable diseases, healthy ageing and community health"-@DrTedros

"Yesterday, WHO and @UNICEF published our annual estimates on the levels of immunization coverage in countries around the world. In 2025, 90% of infants globally received at least one dose of a diphtheria, tetanus and pertussis vaccine, and 85 percent completed the full three-dose series. Both measures are slightly higher than 2024, but still below 2019 levels and within the same narrow range since 2009. Even before COVID-19, immunization coverage had stalled globally. The pandemic disrupted routine immunization systems, reversing gains. In response, WHO, UNICEF and @gavi launched the “Big Catch-Up” to reach children who missed out on one or all routine vaccines. Over the past three years, we reached more than 14 of the 34 million “zero-dose” children, delivering more than 125 million doses in 36 countries. Thanks to the Big Catch-Up, we have recovered the ground we lost. However, our new data show there were still an estimated 13.5 million “zero-dose” children under one year of age who did not receive a single vaccine in 2025. While this represents a small improvement on the previous year, it’s far short of the target that countries set for themselves to reduce the number of “zero-dose” children to 6.4 million by 2030. And the gains we see are undermined by a rising number of children who receive one dose, but do not complete the full immunization schedule, leaving them insufficiently protected. Vaccines are among the best investments in public health, health security and sustainable development. They pay a rich dividend in lives saved, and in healthier, safer and more productive populations. WHO calls on all countries and donors to invest in reaching the 2030 target, including by fully funding Gavi"-@DrTedros #VaccinesWork

সেনাবাহিনী প্রধানের সঙ্গে নৌবাহিনী প্রধানের বিদায়ী সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ এবং গার্ড অব অনার প্রদান ঢাকা, ১৬ জুলাই ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): আজ সেনাসদরে বাংলাদেশ নৌবাহিনী প্রধান অ্যাডমিরাল এম নাজমুল হাসান, ওএসপি, এনপিপি, এনডিসি, এনসিসি, পিএসসি সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি-এর সঙ্গে বিদায়ী সৌজন্য সাক্ষাৎ করেন। সাক্ষাৎকালে পারস্পরিক কুশল বিনিময়ের পাশাপাশি বাহিনীদ্বয়ের স্বার্থসংশ্লিষ্ট বিভিন্ন বিষয় নিয়ে মতবিনিময় হয়। সেনাপ্রধান বিদায়ী নৌবাহিনী প্রধানের সুস্বাস্থ্য ও ভবিষ্যৎ জীবনের সার্বিক সাফল্য কামনা করেন। এর আগে, বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর পক্ষ থেকে নৌবাহিনী প্রধানকে আনুষ্ঠানিক গার্ড অব অনার প্রদান করা হয়। এ সময় সেনাসদরের ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্মকর্তাগণ উপস্থিত ছিলেন। সৌহার্দ্যপূর্ণ পরিবেশে অনুষ্ঠিত এ সাক্ষাৎ বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী ও নৌবাহিনীর বিদ্যমান আন্তঃবাহিনী সহযোগিতা ও পারস্পরিক আস্থার প্রতিফলন।

সংবাদ বিজ্ঞপ্তি বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর বৃক্ষরোপণ অভিযান ২০২৬ এর উদ্বোধন করলেন সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান ঢাকা, ১৬ জুলাই ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): আজ সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান জেনারেল ওয়াকার-উজ-জামান, এসবিপি, ওএসপি, এসজিপি, পিএসসি ঢাকা সেনানিবাসস্থ নির্ঝর আবাসিক এলাকায় গাছের চারা রোপণের মাধ্যমে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর বৃক্ষরোপণ অভিযান-২০২৬ এর শুভ উদ্বোধন করেন। একইসাথে দেশের অন্যান্য সকল সেনানিবাস, ডিওএইচএস এবং জলসিঁড়ি আবাসন প্রকল্প এলাকাসমূহেও বৃক্ষরোপণ কর্মসূচী পালিত হচ্ছে। 'বৃক্ষরোপণে সাজাই দেশ, সবার আগে বাংলাদেশ' এই প্রতিপাদ্যে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর বৃক্ষরোপণ অভিযান-২০২৬ এ সকল সেনানিবাস, ডিওএইচএস এবং জলসিঁড়ি আবাসন প্রকল্প এলাকার উপযুক্ত স্থানে ফলজ, বনজ ও ঔষধি প্রজাতির বৃক্ষসহ সৌন্দর্যবর্ধক গাছের চারা রোপণ করা হবে। এ কর্মসূচি সেপ্টেম্বর ২০২৬ মাসের শেষ সপ্তাহ পর্যন্ত চলমান থাকবে। দেশের বনজ সম্পদ বৃদ্ধি ও পরিবেশগত ভারসাম্য রক্ষার লক্ষ্যে সকলকে স্বপ্রণোদিত হয়ে বৃক্ষরোপণে উৎসাহিত করাই এই বৃক্ষরোপণ কর্মসূচীর মূল উদ্দেশ্য। অনুষ্ঠানে সেনাসদর ও ঢাকা অঞ্চলের ঊর্ধ্বতন সেনা কর্মকর্তাগণ, বিভিন্ন পর্যায়ের সামরিক ও অসামরিক সদস্যবৃন্দ এবং গণমাধ্যম ব্যক্তিবর্গ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

Fedorov said he identified 11 major problems after his first month as minister of defense: "1. Ukraine's Armed Forces are fighting at the tactical level, although increasingly at the operational level too. Still, fundamentally, "we are still fighting tactically". 2. The corps system has not yet fully taken shape. "We have corps that are successful, that advance every month and do not lose territory. And we have corps where the commander is replaced every month. There are corps that have developed their own school of thought and philosophy, and there are corps where we do not even know how many brigades they have or what is happening inside them. Everything depends on organization, but there are corps that do not distribute all their resources internally," Fedorov said. 3. Brigades and corps have been fragmented. "There are brigades that cannot even determine how many battalions they have. A battalion is pulled out of one brigade and thrown into another. It is impossible to build a management system under conditions like these," the defense minister said. 4. No one is held accountable for anything. "Responsibility is always pushed down the chain. Someone else is always made to carry the blame, there is always talk of an investigation and of 'finding out who is guilty'," Fedorov said. 5. Supplies are not routed through the corps. Fedorov said the supply problem is "fundamental": "Over the past five months, we have bought more drones than in the whole of last year, but most units have not felt the impact, because everything is distributed manually: if you are loyal, you get something, if you are not, you don't... That is why we launched this system. It was four months of hell, because it took us four months to agree on a simple project for baseline drone provision to brigades." 6. Constant replacement of commanders. 7. Isolation and toxic treatment of those who deliver results. "If you succeed, you become a star, and then you hit a dead end. [General Mykhailo] Drapatyi received his third reprimand, goodbye. Sorry, Drapatyi, I think after this speech there will be a fourth reprimand for you. I wouldn't want that to happen, but we have no choice left but to talk about it," Fedorov said. 8. It is impossible to carry out any systemic project. "Because you constantly run into the same questions: 'But why?' and 'But how?'" the acting defense minister explained. 9. Human capital is being worn down without proper analysis. Fedorov said they had carried out "a great deal of work", including analyzing losses. "But decisions about who should be supported, who should not, who should be reinforced and who should not are not based on data. They are based on loyalty," he said. 10. The blocking of initiatives and the "bureaucratic crossfire". "In six months at the Defense Ministry, we have not been able to change the organizational structure because the General Staff refuses to approve it: the name is supposedly wrong, something else is not right, or there is allegedly no need to bring in new people," Fedorov explained. 11. Constant dishonesty. "This applies to me too: claims that I ordered the investigation into Skelia, that I launched a media campaign, that I did this or that," the acting defense minister said. [The Ukrainian State Bureau of Investigation is conducting a criminal probe into the Skelia unit – 425th Separate Assault Regiment – following reports of at least 26 noncombat deaths, physical abuse, and inadequate medical care for recruits. The unit's commander was suspended, and authorities are currently investigating allegations of systemic abuse – ed.] He added that he had proposed changes on all points. "What solutions were proposed at the time? Radical personnel decisions. That meant changing both the Commander-in-Chief and the Chief of the General Staff… It meant creating an environment where strong leaders could develop instead of being held back or constantly reprimanded. It meant working with IT specialists and smart people. It meant a different management approach. It meant appointing strong corps commanders. Drone-assault units are a fundamental change in the way we think about deploying infantry: technology must be at the forefront of combat. We should lose drones, not people, and only then should infantry move in," Fedorov said. He also proposed "levelling out" the front line and implementing a doctrine based on the principle of "not losing personnel where it can be avoided", while taking the terrain and the situation into account. "The allocation of all resources through corps – that means personnel, drones, artillery, training… Because there are situations where, ultimately, no one is responsible for a section of the front line," said the acting minister. He also said he had proposed establishing an Academy of Modern Warfare to train new leaders capable of commanding headquarters and units, creating a consortium of Ballistics and Anti-Ballistics units, closing the skies, achieving victory in the economic war and, more broadly, transforming the defence forces and rooting out corruption in procurement. pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/…

Speaking to reporters in Kyiv, Mykahilo Fedorov confirmed that he had been in conflict with Ukraine's commander in chief, Oleksandr Syrsky. He said that he had previously suggested to Zelenskyy that the general be dismissed, but the president refused. For his part, Syrsky gave the president "an ultimatum" to get rid of Fedorov. "When the president said that he did not plan to dismiss Syrsky, I said that I agree, this is his decision as the Supreme Commander-in-Chief, and I will learn to work with him," Fedorov said. "But we faced a complete obstruction of all our initiatives. And Syrsky is not ready to openly address problems," he continued, saying the general seemed more concerned about those plotting "campaigns against him." "And he gave an ultimatum. And instead of figuring out how to asymmetrically defeat Russia [together], he figured out how to split the country." He gave Syrsky credit for "sav[ing] our country in 2022" when Russia first invaded and the general led operations around Kyiv that ultimately pushed by the invading force. "But the war has changed,” said Fedorov, and Syrsky was not changing with it.

केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने स्वर्गीय श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी के निधन पर भेजा शोक संदेश, परिवार के साथ जताई संवेदना एस्सेल ग्रुप के चेयरमैन डॉक्टर सुभाष चंद्रा के पिता जी स्वर्गीय श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी के निधन पर केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने भी अपनी शोक संवेदनाएं जताई हैं. डॉक्टर सुभाष चंद्रा के नाम लिखे एक पत्र में शाह ने 'श्रीमद्भागवत' में भगवान श्रीकृष्ण की वाणी का उल्लेख करते हुए अपने श्रद्धा सुमन अर्पित किए. अमित शाह ने लिखा, 'आपके पिता श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी के निधन का दुःखद समाचार प्राप्त हुआ. ये समाचार सुनकर मन अत्यंत व्यथित एवं हृदय मर्माहत है. पिताश्री के चले जाने पर जीवन में आई रिक्तता को शब्दों में व्यक्त नहीं किया जा सकता है. आपके परिवार पर आई इस दुःख की घड़ी में मैं गहरी संवेदना एवं शोक व्यक्त करता हूं.' गृह मंत्री अमित शाह ने अपने पत्र में आगे लिखा, 'दुःख, शोक और पीड़ा की स्थिति में हम भारतवासियों को अपने पूज्य शास्त्रों से साहस और बल मिलता है. श्रीमद्भागवत में भगवान् श्रीकृष्ण कहते हैं कि 'जिसने जन्म लिया है, उसकी मृत्यु निश्चित है और जिसकी मृत्यु हो गई है, उसका जन्म निश्चित है. इसलिये यह जन्म-मरण रूप भाव अपरिहार्य है, अर्थात् किसी प्रकार भी इसका प्रतिकार नहीं किया जा सकता है. मैं, दिवंगत जीवात्मा को विनम्र श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करते हुए ईश्वर से प्रार्थना करता हूं कि दिवंगत आत्मा को अपने श्रीचरणों में स्थान दें एवं शोकाकुल परिवार को इस अपूरणीय क्षति को सहन करने की अदम्य शक्ति प्रदान करें. . . आपको बताते चलें कि स्वर्गीय श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका के निधन के बाद उन्हें श्रद्धांजलि देने वालों का तांता लगा हुआ है. हिसार स्थित घर से लेकर उनको नजदीक से जानने वाले लोग, जो जहां भी हैं, वहीं से स्वर्गीय श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी को अपने श्रद्धासुमन अर्पित कर रहे हैं. प्रधानमंत्री ने भी अपनी संवेदना जताते हुए एस्सेल ग्रुप के चेयरमैन डॉक्टर सुभाष चंद्रा को पत्र लिखकर अपनी भावनाएं व्यक्त की थीं. श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी के निधन पर राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ (आरएसएस) ने दुःख जताते हुए कहा कि वह अपने जीवनपर्यंत गोसेवा और सामाजिक कार्यों में सक्रिय रहे. राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ के सरसंघचालक मोहन भागवत और सरकार्यवाह दत्तात्रेय होसबाले ने श्री नंद किशोर गोयनका जी के निधन पर कहा था कि वे जीवनपर्यंत गोसेवा सहित विभिन्न सामाजिक कार्यों में सक्रिय रहे. ईश्वर से यह प्रार्थना है कि उनकी आत्मा को सद्गति तथा समस्त गोयनका परिवार एवं सभी स्नेही-मित्रगण को इस दुःख की घड़ी में बल प्रदान करें. #DrSubhashChandra #NandkishoreGoenka #ZeeNews #SubhashChandra @subhashchandra

The mask is off. The organized opposition to data centers is admitting it's about degrowth. "it is easier to mobilize communities to block something than it is to build something." They're being clear about what their goals are. Tear it down. Don't build anything. No no no. The irony is that the data center buildout is one of the biggest tailwinds for zero-emissions technologies like solar and battery storage, not to mention advanced nuclear. It's driving record volumes of private capital (not government subsidies) into these technologies to power the facilities. Yet the groups that claim to support a "clean energy future" are trying to block it. The incentive structure is to oppose, not support. Stopping projects, regardless of what they are, is the tangible win that can be shared with their funders to generate more cash. The same campaign has also been one of the loudest opponents to permitting reform. Renewable energy developers will tell you that arguably the biggest obstacle to their growth is the antiquated federal permitting system that delays projects and encourages litigation. And who is filing those lawsuits? The same groups leading the organized opposition to data centers. This isn't the same thing as a local community asking questions about water use or electricity infrastructure. As with fracking, real local concerns can typically be addressed by adjusting development plans and other standard operating procedures. But the big, organized opposition to data centers - which is shaping many of the headlines and discouraging local residents from accepting anything other than a complete ban - isn't interested in negotiation or finding a path forward for economic growth. Because for them, that's just not where the money is.

Islamabad: 15 July 2026. United Nations Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs and Emergency Relief Coordinator, Mr. Tom Fletcher, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House today. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Adviser to the Prime Minister Dr. Syed Tauqir Shah, Chairman National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) Lieutenant General Inam Haider Malik, and other senior officials attended the meeting. The Prime Minister appreciated the invaluable humanitarian work being undertaken by the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) in responding to complex emergencies across the world. He acknowledged OCHA's continued support to Pakistan, particularly during the devastating floods of 2022, and thanked the organization for its assistance in strengthening the country's disaster response efforts. The Prime Minister noted that Pakistan's national and provincial disaster management institutions had significantly enhanced their capacity to respond to climate-induced disasters over the years. He emphasized, however, that the increasing frequency and intensity of climate-related events underscored the need for greater preparedness, resilience, and closer coordination among all stakeholders at the national, regional, and international levels. Mr. Tom Fletcher thanked the Prime Minister for receiving him and appreciated the longstanding partnership and close cooperation between Pakistan and OCHA. He also commended the Prime Minister's efforts to promote regional peace and stability, noting that sustainable peace was essential to addressing the humanitarian and economic consequences of conflicts. During the meeting, Mr. Fletcher briefed the Prime Minister on the humanitarian situation in Gaza and the challenges being faced by OCHA in delivering urgently needed assistance to the affected population. He also expressed appreciation for Pakistan's continued support to OCHA's humanitarian efforts in Afghanistan. The Prime Minister reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to working closely with the United Nations and OCHA to strengthen global humanitarian cooperation, enhance disaster preparedness, and support relief efforts for vulnerable communities affected by conflicts and natural disasters. Якщо Рада сьогодні проведе зміни в Уряді згідно того списку прізвищ, який гуляє у мережі, то мені буде дуже прикро не побачити в Уряді 2 прізвища: Федоров та Лісовий. Знаю не з чуток, яку колосальну роботу виконувала команда Федорова з викорінення корупційних схем у закупівлях. Була добре налаштована комунікація із провідними західними та українськими компаніями, технології яких забезпечили перевагу на полі бою в контексті безпілотної складової. Так, можливо не все було в роботі МО ідеально (а це в принципі неможливо під час війни), але дорікнути Михайлу за відсутність бажання не наважиться ніхто. Тому, дякую за роботу і сподіваюсь, що Михайло і надалі залишиться в обоймі людей, які працюють на Перемогу. Оксен Лісовий курував реформу освіти в Україні: шкільної, професійної, ЗВО. Дуже важкої і болючої, супротив якій чинили і чинять насамперед освітяни, бо будуть закриватись школи, обʼєднуються університети. Але заглядаючи за горизонт кінцевим результатом реформи має стати покращення освітнього процесу і більш ефективний менеджмент коштів на учнів, студентів та викладачів. Філософія «гроші ходять за учнем» має таке ж право на життя, як свого часу Супрунівське «гроші ходять за пацієнтом». Проблема реформ в Україні полягає у тому, що тим, хто їх починає, рідко дають їх завершити. Сьогодні відставку Лісового ректори університетів обмиють шампанським. Президент має власну позицію, яка сьогодні, на жаль, не співпадає з позицією проактивного прошарку українського суспільства. Якби Зеленський дав зрозумілу аргументацію підстав для звільнення - це могло б зняти напругу. Але так не сталося. Дуже прикро, але у нас новий виток протистояння громадянського суспільства і влади. Від себе особисто хочу подякувати Михайлу і Оксену за все що було зроблено і сподіваюсь, що наступники не поламають вектор руху обох міністерств.

वनडे मैच के दौरान आईसीसी आचार संहिता के लेवल 1 के उल्लंघन के लिए चेतावनी दी गई है. आईसीसी के अनुसार, बराड़ को खिलाड़ियों और सहयोगी स्टाफ के लिए आईसीसी आचार संहिता के अनुच्छेद 2.9 के उल्लंघन का दोषी पाया गया. यह उल्लंघन अंतरराष्ट्रीय मैच के दौरान "किसी खिलाड़ी पर अनुचित या खतरनाक तरीके से गेंद फेंकने" से संबंधित है. इस घटना के लिए उनके अनुशासनात्मक रिकॉर्ड में एक डिमेरिट अंक भी जोड़ दिया गया है. यह घटना इंग्लैंड की पारी के आठवें ओवर में हुई जब बराड़ ने अपनी ही गेंदबाजी पर गेंद को फील्ड किया और उसे बल्लेबाज की ओर अनुचित और खतरनाक तरीके से फेंक दिया. उस समय इंग्लैंड के बल्लेबाज बेन डकेट क्रीज पर मौजूद थे. मैच रेफरी द्वारा इस हरकत को 'अनुचित और खतरनाक' माना गया. . . मैदानी अंपायर कुमार धर्मसेना और माइक बर्न्स, तीसरे अंपायर सैम नोगाजस्की और चौथे अंपायर रसेल वारेन ने ये आरोप लगाए थे. आईसीसी नियमों के अनुसार, लेवल 1 के उल्लंघन में कम से कम आधिकारिक फटकार, अधिकतम खिलाड़ी की मैच फीस का 50 प्रतिशत जुर्माना और एक या दो डिमेरिट अंक देने का प्रावधान है. जब कोई खिलाड़ी 24 महीने की अवधि के भीतर चार या उससे अधिक डिमेरिट अंक तक पहुंच जाता है, तो उन्हें निलंबन अंकों में बदल दिया जाता है और खिलाड़ी पर प्रतिबंध लगा दिया जाता है. दो निलंबन अंक होने पर खिलाड़ी को एक टेस्ट, दो वनडे या दो टी20 से प्रतिबंधित कर दिया जाता है, जो भी मैच पहले आए. आईसीसी द्वारा दिए गए ये डिमेरिट अंक खिलाड़ी के रिकॉर्ड पर 24 महीने तक बने रहते हैं, जिसके बाद उन्हें हटा दिया जाता है. भारत ने पहले वनडे में इंग्लैंड को छह विकेट से हराकर सीरीज में 1-0 की बढ़त बना ली है, जिसमें बराड़ ने दो विकेट चटकाए थे. अब दोनों टीमें गुरुवार को कार्डिफ में होने वाले दूसरे वनडे में भिड़ेंगी. आईसीसी ने जानकारी दी है कि बराड़ ने अपना Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, held discussions with Dr. V. Kalaiselvan, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC), to explore collaborative initiatives for strengthening pharmacovigilance, materiovigilance, and healthcare systems in India. The discussions explored the establishment of Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI) and Materiovigilance Programme of India (MvPI) Centres in Aspirational Districts to strengthen patient safety and healthcare systems at the grassroots. Deliberations also covered aligning the standards of the Indian Pharmacopoeia with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), promoting the National Formulary of India among registered medical practitioners through the National Medical Commission, and advancing collaboration to strengthen healthcare delivery. Dr. Y. K. Gupta, President, AIIMS Kalyani; Dr. Pooja Gupta, Department of Pharmacology, AIIMS New Delhi; and Dr. T. Velpandian, Dr. R. P. Centre for Ophthalmic Sciences, AIIMS New Delhi, joined the discussions virtually. Prof. (Dr.) M. It's not a technical problem. The developers have been tasked with solving the unsolvable. The question is simple: How old is ______________? How can you possibly answer that without vital context; the person's identity? So what's next in the global push for age verification? #ID checkpoints everywhere, real-time video/audio, geolocation, outlawed & undermined cryptography - traceability from end to end... to "protect the children" No #privacy, no rights... and no say in the matter. We're sleep walking into the abyss. Wake up.

At State House Nairobi, commissioned consultations and eventual preparation of Kenya's inaugural State of Openness Report. It will establish a national benchmark for measuring transparency, accountability and institutional performance across Government, while providing an honest assessment of where we are succeeding, what we must improve and the reforms necessary to strengthen public trust. I direct every ministry, department, agency, constitutional commission and county government to extend their full cooperation to the Commission on Administrative Justice by providing timely, accurate and comprehensive information throughout this exercise. Our report on the state of openness, to be launched later in the year, will be the first of its kind in the world.

We have also implemented electronic procurement to enhance transparency, promote fair competition and ensure prudent use of public resources. To ensure openness to Government Owned Enterprises, we have enacted a law that is helping strengthen transparent, merit-based and competitive recruitment free from political influence. Additionally, the enactment of the Conflict of Interest Act has further reinforced integrity by strengthening transparency, accountability and ethical conduct of public officers. In the implementation of the National Infrastructure Fund (NIF), we have also introduced robust mechanisms to strengthen openness and transparency, limiting the President's role in the appointment of the NIF Council, enhancing institutional independence and accountability.
We have introduced a Unified Government Digital Payment Platform to eliminate leakages, reduce opportunities for corruption and strengthen accountability in the collection of public revenue.

COVID-19, conflict, climate and economic shocks and disruptions to energy, fertiliser and trade have shown how quickly pressure in one part of the world can spread through food systems and reach communities thousands of miles away. At the #HLPF in New York, @IFAD hosted a High-Level Roundtable on a difficult but necessary question: How do we finance agrifood systems that can better withstand the next shock? The discussion confirmed that this is no longer only an agricultural issue. Food-system resilience is inseparable from economic security, geopolitical stability and international cooperation. Shocks are transmitted through energy, fertiliser, trade and food markets. In many African countries, for example, more than 80% of fertiliser is imported. Disruption or price volatility in global markets can therefore quickly affect planting decisions, harvests and rural incomes. Small-scale producers and rural entrepreneurs feel these pressures first. Rising input costs and reduced access to finance determine whether they can plant, invest, hire workers or take produce to market. But vulnerability can be reduced. Better fertiliser application and combining organic and inorganic inputs can cut fertiliser use by 25–30% while sustaining or increasing yields. What happens at the #FirstMile shapes food availability, prices, and rural incomes. If disruptions persist, as many as 45 million additional people could face acute food insecurity. Resilience must be financed before the next crisis arrives. That investment must begin at the first mile. Lord Fatafehi Fakafānua, Prime Minister of Tonga, underlined this and brought in the perspective of countries already facing climate and economic vulnerability. Through #IFAD14, we can bring governments, development finance institutions, the private sector and other partners around a shared agenda: addressing immediate food-security pressures while building stronger rural economies and more resilient agrifood systems. @GovIE | @ItalyMFA_int | @ItalyMFA | @MFAEthiopia | @PolandMFA | @PremierRP | @RockefellerFdn #FinancingTheFirstMile

পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে আত্মোৎসর্গকারী ল্যান্স নায়েক মো: কাজী আবুল বাশার, বীর প্রতীক, ইস্ট বেঙ্গল-এর ৩৭তম শাহাদাত বার্ষিক ঢাকা, ১৬ জুলাই ২০২৬ (বৃহস্পতিবার): পার্বত্য চট্টগ্রামে কর্তব্য পালনকালে শাহাদাতবরণকারী ল্যান্স নায়েক মো: কাজী আবুল বাশার, বীর প্রতীক, ইস্ট বেঙ্গল-এর আজ ৩৭তম শাহাদাত বার্ষিকী। ল্যান্স নায়েক মো: কাজী আবুল বাশার, বীর প্রতীক, ১৯৮৯ সালে তৎকালীন ৪৩ ইস্ট বেঙ্গল এর সাথে পানছড়ি জোনে কর্মরত ছিলেন। গত ১৬ জুলাই ১৯৮৯ তারিখে পানছড়ি আর্মি ক্যাম্প থেকে খাগড়াছড়ি যাওয়ার পথে অধিনায়কের নিরাপত্তা এসকর্ট এর গাড়ির চালকের দায়িত্বে ছিলেন। গাড়িটি দুপুর ১৩২৮ ঘটিকায় মনিগ্রাম এলাকায় পৌঁছালে শান্তিবাহিনী সন্ত্রাসীদের এ্যাম্বুশে পতিত হয়। শান্তিবাহিনীর এলএমজি’র প্রথম বার্স্টে গাড়ির দ্বিতীয় আসনে থাকা হাবিলদার মফিজ উদ্দিন সঙ্গে সঙ্গে শাহাদত বরণ করেন। ল্যান্স নায়েক কাজী আবুল বাশার নিজেও বুকে, হাতে ও পায়ে গুলিবিদ্ধ হন। মারাত্মক আহত অবস্থায়ও তিনি নিজের জীবন বিপন্ন করে ০৮ জন সৈনিক, অস্ত্র ও গাড়ি রক্ষার সর্বাত্মক চেষ্টা চালান। তিনি এ্যাম্বুশ এলাকা থেকে গাড়ি নিরাপদ স্থানে নিয়ে যাওয়ার জন্য গতিমাত্রা বাড়িয়ে দেন এবং গাড়িটি এ্যাম্বুশ এলাকা থেকে বের করে আনতে সক্ষম হন। তবে, অতিরিক্ত রক্তক্ষরণে তিনি দুর্বল হয়ে গাড়ির নিয়ন্ত্রণ হারিয়ে ফেলেন, যার ফলে গাড়িটি রাস্তার পাশে পড়ে যায়। পরবর্তীতে, ঘটনাস্থলেই তিনি শাহাদত বরণ করেন। ল্যান্স নায়েক কাজী আবুল বাশারের অসীম সাহসিকতা, বিচক্ষণতা ও আত্মত্যাগের ফলে ০৮ জন সৈনিকের জীবন, মূল্যবান অস্ত্র ও সরকারি সম্পদ রক্ষা পায়। তাঁর এই অনন্য সাহসিকতার জন্য তাঁকে মহামান্য রাষ্ট্রপতি কর্তৃক 'বীর প্রতীক' খেতাবে ভূষিত করা হয়।
